body.name: v13.2.0
body.message:
fix(jobparser): incomplete job definition triggers pre-execution-error inside a reusable workflow (#1747)

Remove the incorrect job qualifying when namespaces are enabled.

Reviewed-on: https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/pulls/1747

body.name: v13.1.0
body.message:
fix: move environment-related description fields from capability to create RPC (#1719)

Fields that could vary between different environments in a plugin, such as the operating system identifier, are now returned in the `CreateResponse` rather than the `CapabilitiesResponse`.

Fixes #1677.

Reviewed-on: https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/pulls/1719
Reviewed-by: Andreas Ahlenstorf <redacted@example.invalid>
